prior_exposure: Earlier whole-range source-role review; actual three caller ranges read before the detailed author packet. No authorship of these grouped source relationships.
primary_read: Stein author-hosted book, printed88: equation5.3.1, Theorems5.8 and5.9; direct local image.
Diamond–Im printed119–120: generic cuspidal representations, characteristic polynomial, arithmetic Frobenius and newform dependence; direct local images.
Deligne–Serre printed508–510 and512: character decomposition, good Hecke formula, primitive/oldform decomposition, and cusp coefficient-field statement; direct local images.
findings: The divisor-sum recurrence gives good-prime eigenvalue alpha(p)+p beta(p), determinant p alpha(p)beta(p). The constant term also satisfies the formula: zero if alpha is nontrivial, correct scalar if alpha=1.

For p not dividing t, substitution q->q^t commutes with good T_p. The exceptional weight-two trivial-character combination E2(q)-tE2(q^t) has eigenvalue1+p for such p, including composite t. No broad Theorem5.10 claim is used.

The finite character pair alpha plus beta times cyclotomic character realizes the required arithmetic-Frobenius trace/determinant. Cuspidal constituents use Diamond–Im, not the weight-one Artin theorem.
The scalar trace/determinant belongs to one two-dimensional constituent and acts by identity on its old multiplicity space. It is not the trace/determinant of all old copies.

Finite Fourier coordinates separate the fixed finite-dimensional space. Its integral coefficient submodule is finitely generated over the coefficient DVR and compact, hence closed. No saturation or integral eigenspace projector is inferred.

The accepted Cox finite-Chebotarev replacement, not the old Milne snapshot, supplies finite-quotient approximation. Simultaneous finite-image conditions and finite exclusions suffice; continuity then preserves the closed module.
source_version_boundary: Stein is the exact authorized author-hosted hyperlinked book, whose official author README links this PDF and thanks AMS for free availability. limits: Only good primes outside the level and2; no all-Hecke eigenform assertion at level primes.
Actual modularity, coefficient field, q-expansion uniqueness and integral diamond/Hecke translates remain incoming as stated.
This does not reprove integer divisibility, later trace nilpotence, or theta source completeness.
